expectations.text: Guides auditing existing 40+ components for patterns and inconsistencies
expectations.evidence: Suggests creating a component inventory but does not provide a structured audit methodology or categorization framework

expectations.text: Extracts design tokens from existing codebase
expectations.evidence: Recommends creating a tokens file with colors, spacing, and typography — gives example token structures

expectations.text: Establishes atomic design structure (atoms, molecules, organisms)
expectations.evidence: Mentions atomic design and suggests organizing components by level, though without mapping existing components

expectations.text: Defines token naming conventions for the team
expectations.evidence: Uses ad-hoc names in examples but does not establish a systematic naming convention schema

expectations.text: Creates a refactoring plan to replace hardcoded values with tokens
expectations.evidence: Says to replace hardcoded values but no phased plan, no priority ordering, no effort estimates

expectations.text: Produces a design system setup deliverable
expectations.evidence: Provides conversational guidance and code snippets but no structured design system deliverable document
